context: Quarterly review with Tern Freight, a freight broker using our dispatch software. Contact: Gina Wolfe, head of operations. Contract: 45 dispatcher seats, $22,500 per year, renewal on 1 November. Their goal for this year was a conversion rate of 3 percent on web quotes. Fuel surcharge reports are included.

lines.text: hi gina thanks for making time pavel good to see you too

lines.speaker: Gina
lines.text: hello sam so the team has shrunk we are down to about thirty dispatchers now not forty five
that is a big drop from the contract i will check the seat report

lines.speaker: Pavel
lines.text: finance wants the whole cost of this tool under eighteen thousand next year
understood i will keep that in mind

lines.speaker: Gina
lines.text: our web quotes convert at two point one percent and the goal was three
that is below target so the funnel needs a look

lines.speaker: Pavel
lines.text: the renewal is on the first of november but our budget freeze starts the fifteenth of october

lines.speaker: Gina
lines.text: late deliveries went down from eleven percent to seven percent since we started using your alerts
that is good news for the renewal

lines.speaker: Pavel
lines.text: a competitor quoted us a flat nineteen thousand for unlimited seats
i would compare what each offer includes

lines.speaker: Gina
lines.text: it has been raining here for four days straight
same here the roads were flooded this morning

lines.speaker: Pavel
lines.text: i will email you the seat report tomorrow
